name: Paulina Lewandowski
headline: Product Strategy | Product thinking for people who build the future.
summary:
When you start thinking like a product builder, everything changes: you become more customer-centric, you choose the right opportunities (instead of all of them), and you build an ecosystem that delivers simplicity, scalability, and freedom. For you and for your customers.

My goal is to make product thinking accessible to everyone: every business, every builder. I am like a little voice that translates the lessons of product management into practical tools for everyday use.

In the age of AI, where opportunities are endless and overwhelming, I’m here to provide a guidebook. Not just for building something, but for building the right thing: with focus, with value, and with fun.
